draft_subject: Architecture research-student preparation: portfolio, recommendations and later doctorate route
draft_body:
Dear programme team,

Your April 2027 self-supporting research-student page lists Architecture-specific portfolio and recommendation requirements (https://ois.t.u-tokyo.ac.jp/admission/selfRS_EngineeringTcens.html).

I’m developing Proxy Society, an architecture research project on AI agents and robots acting for absent people under limited, revocable mandates. The proposed pilot compares a civic threshold under ordinary booking, human assistance and staged AI delegation, preserving personal attendance. I am mapping the preparation route before selecting a prospective supervisor.

Could you confirm which Architecture-specific steps and current deadlines apply to an international research-student enquiry, and how the department’s general six-month Kenkyusei requirement connects to a later doctorate application?

Best regards,
Kris Haamer
Proxy Society
https://proxysociety.org/architecture

Dear programme team,

Your graduate guideline index links the April 2027 regular doctoral guide and separates international graduate programme information (https://admissions.isct.ac.jp/ja/013/graduate/guideline).

I’m developing Proxy Society, an architecture research project on AI agents and robots acting for absent people under limited, revocable mandates. The proposed architectural study would test visible limits and cancellation of an AI proxy’s room-booking mandate at a staffed civic threshold, preserving a person’s own arrival. I am preparing a programme-specific research-plan route.

Could you clarify where an overseas applicant should compare the regular doctorate, IGP and research-student categories, including any individual eligibility assessment? I would follow each lab’s published consultation process.

Best regards,
Kris Haamer
